scientific_scope: exact reconstruction of only the four pre-existing E extremisers; no search, optimisation, parameter grid, or new law

process_and_estimand.estimand: Delta_t = Pr(nonextinct at t | buffer patch 0) - Pr(nonextinct at t | doubled colonisation), from all four patches occupied
process_and_estimand.data_generating_process: iid exchangeable hazard pattern at each model step; mortality precedes same-step recolonisation from surviving occupied patches; zero occupancy is absorbing
process_and_estimand.scope_of_inference: n=4, t=0..50, p=1/10, e0=1/50, e1=9/10, c=1/10 and the four named laws only
process_and_estimand.actions_and_baseline: K0 uses ordinary mortality and c; KR halves hazard-attributable excess mortality at labelled patch 0 and uses c; KC uses ordinary mortality and 2c

kernel_validation.independent_derivation: closed sum over exact survivor subsets versus source nested survivor/colonisation enumeration

interpretive_findings.fixed_T_prefix_warning: cum_Delta_by_t in the source is a prefix of a T=50 hybrid allocation and is not Delta at a shorter horizon
interpretive_findings.hit_is_not_death: a k=4 hazard hit is not an all-four mortality event; extinction depends on occupancy and realised deaths
interpretive_findings.conditional_vs_weighted_warning: the conditional one-step survival contrast under an all-four hit is not the weighted T=50 k=4 contribution
interpretive_findings.source_provenance_gap: mechanism_decomposition.json and .log contain no source hashes; exact values are externally bound here to two independently saved certificate/audit artefacts
interpretive_findings.colonisation_quiet_step_fraction: forward k=0 Gamma shares are 57.2% to 72.3%; reverse shares are 46.0% to 61.3%, so 'almost entirely at k=0' is unsupported and q=.03 E-max reverse has a larger k=1 share
interpretive_findings.order_dependence: overall Delta is invariant, but q=.06 E-max k=1 net changes sign from positive forward to negative reverse, so ordering can change a category-level qualitative statement
interpretive_findings.extinction_timing: R has the exact one-step advantage at all four laws. The minimisers cross to C at horizons 4 and 11; maximisers retain R's advantage for every t=1..50, with equality only at t=0
interpretive_findings.last_death_semantics: extinction occurs when every currently occupied patch dies in the mortality phase; same-step colonisation needs at least one survivor, so zero is absorbing. A k=4 hazard hit need not be extinction
